jobs_results.title: Full Stack Developer (Java)
jobs_results.description:
Digital+ is the team of Digital Solutions within Applus+ Laboratories.

We provide web applications for our customers to R&D. Our team develops online and on-premise solutions for data management on materials and testing for industry customers as well as for our test labs of Applus+ Laboratories.

We are looking a to Full Stack Developer (Java) to enrich our team with dedicated, communicative and skilled developers to support our products and projects development teams in Europe.

Your Activities:
• Software development of clean and efficient code on Java ecosystem
• Conception, development, documentation and testing of engineering applications (full stack) for products as well as customer projects
• Technical responsibility for developed features and modules, e.g. specification, programming and documentation
• Integration of developed modules within existing frameworks and architecture
• Technical advice on requirements and optimized feature implementation
• Participation in exciting... digitalization projects from the idea to the rollout

Your Profile:
• Bachelors or Master degree in IT-
• At least 2 years professional experience using the Java-stack
• Very good knowledge of Java frameworks (e.g., Spring Boot)
• Practical experience in FE technologies (e.g. JavaScript, Typescript)
• Confident use of Gradle, GIT, Gitlab and CI/CD pipelines
• Good knowledge of spoken and written English (C1). German is a plus.
• Motivated, team-oriented, structured and independent
• Knowledge of cloud-related technologies (OAuth 2.0, OpenAPI, Kubernetes) and databases (SQL, NoSQL) (optional)
• Interested in engineering topics (optional)

Our offer:
• Options within an international environment
• Context with very good salary
• Home office and working hours
• Team events
• Opportunity for relocation to Dresden (Germany). At the location Dresden: lunch subsidies, work bike, etc

jobs_results.title: Senior Fullstack Developer
jobs_results.description:
About us :

As the European market leader, NEXTLANE develops and delivers digital solutions for the automotive industry by connecting the systems of manufacturers and dealers.

We develop integrated end-to-end software and digital solutions that digitize and simplify the entire automotive customer journey.

Our mission is to empower our clients to boost their business operations and optimize their customer experience through innovative solutions. Our comprehensive software suite revolutionizes every aspect of new and used vehicle sales and management.

📋 Context of the Position :

We are seeking a Senior Fullstack Developer for a development team working with PHP and Node.js. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background, particularly in designing and implementing software arquitectures.
• **This position is based in Madrid.

🎯 Your responsibilities :

• Lead cross-functional teams to design, implement, test, and deploy software solutions.

• Provide technical... leadership, making critical decisions on technology and implementations.

• Ensure robust and well-documented code across the software development lifecycle.

🕵️ What we are looking for :

Experience: 5 years of experience in related positions.

Languages:
• High English level C1 (French could be a plus).

Technical Skills:

• Proficiency in cloud architecture and a strong understanding of AWS services

• Good knowledge in JavaScript, with a strong understanding of both frontend and backend development.

• Experience developing with VUE and PHP

• Must have experience with Mongo DB.

• Good knowledge and experience with relational and non-relational databases

Interpersonal skills:

• Excellent time management and organizational skills.

• Strong problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to tackle complex technical challenges.

• Effective communication and teamwork skills.

• Adaptability and a willingness to learn new technologies and frameworks.

🤝 Our Recruitment Process:
• 15-minute call with our Talent Acquisition Specialist.
• Teams meeting with our Hiring Manager.
• Technical Test
• Teams meeting with our HR BP.

Join us and be part of the Nextlane adventure that is shaping the future of the automotive industry!

💎 Our Advantages:

We value flexibility and trust within our corporate culture, offering benefits that reflect our commitment to our teams:

🏡 Possibility to telework up to 3 days a week!

🤝 €600 referral bonus for each talent you capture. (after the 6-month tiral period).

🍱 Flexible Remuneration (COBEE).

👩 ⚕️ Medical Insurance (Adeslas).

📒 Access to a dedicated internal training platform for continuous learning.

🌴 23 days of vacation. Intensive day July and August.

🤝 Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Belonging:

We are committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued in the workplace. We believe that the company and its culture are strongest when they are made up of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

We welcome applications from people with disabilities. If you are a person with a disability and need help, please let us know so we can talk about how we can best support and make any adjustments that may be necessary.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

🌍 What does it mean to work at Nextlane?

Join a young and fast-growing company, where you can work on new and ambitious projects.

International and multicultural environment.

Collaboration between colleagues.

We truly believe that Nextlane is a great place to work and develop your talent! Sign up for our offer and find out why

jobs_results.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs_results.description:
¿Eres de esas personas que se mueve como pez en el agua tanto en el Back como en el Front?¿Te sientes orgullos@ de tu trabajo y estás buscando un nuevo reto que te apasione? El equipo de inmovilla by idealista está en pleno crecimiento y te invitamos a ser parte de un proyecto puntero. Inmovilla es un CRM inmobiliario en la nube, líder en integración de datos de diferentes plataformas inmobiliarias. Estamos buscando a alguien como tú para unirse a nuestro equipo en un rol presencial con posibilidad híbrida.

¿Qué harás?
• Trabajarás junto a tus compañer@s del equipo desarrollando nuevas funcionalidades.
• Tendrás un trato fluido con la gente de negocio para poder entender sus necesidades y problemas. Además, trabajarás codo con codo con nuestro equipo de producto para aportar una visión técnica a las soluciones que definamos para los mismos.

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

Ahí va :)
• Vas a aprender. Lo decimos en serio. La plataforma va evolucionando constantemente, y de ahí sacamos mogollón de... charlas internas, posts, talleres… que hacen que el conocimiento fluya.
• Además... patrocinamos eventos, acudimos a ellos y hacemos muchos meetups. ¡Es tan importante aprender como enseñar a tus compis!
• Tenemos las buenas prácticas y el código limpio por bandera
• Además de trabajar, nos gusta pasarlo bien, por eso que si te unes a nuestras familia, cada mes celebrarás algo…Halloween, San Valentín, Navidad,…¡Te lo vas a pasar muy bien!
• Teambuilding y mucho más!

Requisitos importantes para trabajar con nosotros.
• Experiencia con JavaScript
• Experiencia con HTML5 y CSS3
• Experiencia con PHP
• Experiencia con MySQL
• Experiencia con React

Sería genial si además tienes…
• Conocimiento en JSON, XML
• Conocimiento en API REST
• Conocimientos de principios SOLID
• Experiencia en la creación de aplicaciones web orientadas a objetos
• Programación con código limpio, escalable y estructurado

Te reconoces? Acepta el reto!

Te estamos esperando

Descripción del puesto

Desde The Whiteam Consulting seleccionamos un/a fullstack developer con experiencia en .Net y Javascript.

Conocimientos técnicos requeridos:
• .NET
• C#
• HTML, Javascript, CSS
• PL/SQL (Oracle)

Conocimientos técnicos deseables:
• Angular
• C++
• Oracle/Forms

Titulación requerida: Grado superior

Trabajo en modalidad híbrida (2 días de presencialidad a elegir L, X o V por la mañana en Pº Castellana. Horario obligatorio de 9 a 14 horas, resto a elegir.

Compañía

Formar parte de THEWHITEAM es colaborar con una empresa formada por profesionales con una dilatada experiencia en consultoría tecnológica.

Creemos firmemente que las empresas y clientes marcan el camino a seguir en el sector, pero éste lo construyen las personas. Consideramos de vital importancia que nuestra organización se fundamente en nuestro mejor activo y marca de valor añadido que es nuestro equipo humano.

Beneficios

Por otra parte, te dejo también un pequeño resumen de políticas de la... compañía para que nos vayas conociendo un poco mejor:
• Nuestro convenio es el de Consultoras y estudios de mercado
• Tenemos 23 días de vacaciones al año
• La empresa da como regalo el día de nuestro cumpleaños, para que podamos disfrutar de él sin trabajar
• Tenemos 14 pagas, 12 mensuales y dos extras (junio y diciembre)
• Como retribución flexible podemos pedir ticket guardería y también seguro médico + dental

jobs_results.title: Experienced Full stack Java/Angular Software Developer
jobs_results.description:
Your LittleBig responsibilities

LittleBIG Connection is actively looking for an Experience Full stack Java/Angular Software Developer in Valencia to work remotely!

At LittleBIG Connection, we value the role of a software developer. Above and beyond technological aspects, which are constantly changing, the software developer fulfils an important role: building our SaaS solution by translating specific professional, product, and financial needs from our product team, into quality source code, with a focus on design.

Working within a task force, you will help develop one or several modules of the LittleBIG Connection platform and will be fully involved in the team operations.

Software development/product evolutions:
• Analyze and challenge product specifications
• Actively participate in committees
• Manage software development
• Urgently address defects highlighted by the Certification team
• Ensure the continuous update of the JIRA activity repository

Software development/problem... solving, hot fixing & assistance:
• Engage in discussion with support level2 and/or customer support, business teams, and all stakeholders
• Solve problems
• Develop in hot fixing mode (minimal impact, workaround)

Candidate Profile
• Background in IT engineering or similar, desire to evolve in a scale-up environment
• At least 3 years of experience in a similar role
• Good full stack mastery of Java and Angular
• Industry knowledge of the development process (Code Review, Merge Request, Release Maven, …),
• Good Understanding of: JavaScript, GIT, Linux
• Fluent in English
• Passionate about development and technology, your main motivation is your contribution to the evolution of the codebase of an innovative SaaS solution. You will also be eager to investigate and solve problems
• Pragmatic, aware of the constraints and able to propose appropriate solutions
• Knowledge of working in a decentralized environment (multi-site development). You will be active, a good communicator, and a self-starter. You ensure information is shared properly.
• Experience in a high-pressure SaaS-type solution and a B2B environment is desirable.

Going further

We do work using agile methods – Scrum – and give full autonomy to the squad on the process. Each squad and tribe is driven by OKRs giving the directions Product Managers and Technical Leaders should materialize in the Now / Next / Later roadmaps and share to the whole company.

We work on UNIX containerized environment and use Gitlab CI/CD to deploy the applications / microservices regularly (almost 2 releases per year). Our stack includes a common IDE (IntelliJ), postman (API env.), SonarQube, Thrivy and several other tools ensuring high standards for our platform for any new features and easing the migration / remediation of our legacy path.

We are looking for our future teammate, so if you think you fit the profile, don't hesitate to apply!

We look forward to meeting you 😊

We work on UNIX containerized environment and use Gitlab CI/CD to deploy the applications / microservices regularly (almost 2 releases per year). Our stack includes a common IDE (IntelliJ), postman (API env.), SonarQube, Thrivy and several other tools ensuring high standards for our platform for any new features and easing the migration / remediation of our legacy path.

We are looking for our future teammate, so if you think you fit the profile, don't hesitate to apply!

We look forward to meeting you 😊

Únete al equipo de un proyecto de sector turístico y demuestra tu experiencia como Desarrollador/a Fullstack con Java.

En ALTEN tenemos claro que el éxito de nuestros proyectos se debe a las personas que forman nuestro equipo. Por eso, si tienes entre 1 y 3 años de experiencia como desarrollador/a Fullstack con Java, nos comprometemos a impulsar tu talento, satisfacer tus expectativas laborales y hacerte sentir como en casa. ¿Te unes a nuestro #WelcomeHome? ¡Sigue leyendo!

- Experiencia de unos 1 - 3 años como desarrollador/a Fullstack con Java.

- Experiencia con bases de datos relacionales (SQL), Typescript o Javascript.

jobs_results.title: Programador full stack
jobs_results.description:
¿Quieres formar parte de Calímaco?

Te estamos buscando para que formes parte de nuestro equipo de integraciones

Responsabilidades
• Desarrollar servicios construidos en Node.js
• Implementar integraciones de juegos, pagos y terceros para nuestros microservicios
• Mantener el código desarrollado
• Dar soporte a incidencias en producción del código desarrollado, así como soporte de alto nivel a nuestros clientes.
• Desarrollar código legible y fácilmente mantenible por el resto de compañeros del equipo.

Requisitos
• Experiencia ejecutando aplicaciones de microservicios corriendo en kubernetes y Docker
• Experiencia implementando servicios con NodeJs, diseño y construcción de APIs Restfull desde cero.
• Haber trabajado con bases de datos relacionales y JavaScript
• Dominar Git y estar familiarizado/a con herramientas CI/CD como Jenkins o Helm.
• Capacidad para entender los requisitos de negocio entendiendo al cliente y trabajando estrechamente con Producto para encontrar la mejor... solución.
• Altas dotes comunicativas, tanto orales como escritas para facilitar el trato con clientes y proveedores.

Sería un plus aportar:
• Comprensión de la industria del juego
• Conocimiento y manejo de Jira
• Idiomas adicionales como inglés o portugués
